title: What have you done?
description: A picture-based lesson on the present perfect tense (have/has + past participle). Fifteen illustrations show completed actions: aired, cleaned, opened, sharpened, turned on, listened to, boiled, answered, emptied, asked, typed, washed, walked, painted, dusted. Written exercises A (put 'has' in present-perfect sentences) and B (rewrite imperatives as 'I've already done it / I did it...' pairs) are transcribed from the textbook. Workbook practice covers 'Have you ever been to...' dialogues, 'I've already done it / I did it an hour ago' sentence completion, and open-ended situation questions. Grammar exercises practise answering 'and' questions with present-perfect/past-simple pairs and giving correct replies to observations.
answer_note: Written exercise A (put 'has' in present-perfect sentences) 7 blanks are taken from the supplied Lesson 86 key (img/key-085-090.jpg). Written exercise B (rewrite imperatives) 12 items are suggested model answers following the printed example pattern. Workbook practice A ('Has he ever been to...') 4 items are taken from the key (item 1 is a printed example). Workbook practice B ('I've already done it / I did it an hour ago') 6 blanks (3 sentences × 2 blanks) are taken from the key. Workbook practice C (situations) 2 items are taken from the key. Grammar I (answer 'and' questions) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 502). Grammar II (give correct replies) item 1 is a printed example; items 2-10 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 502). No external sources were used.

lesson.text:
Listen and answer the questions.
听录音并回答问题。
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and answer the questions about the fifteen actions shown in the illustrations.

lesson.title: Listen and answer the questions
lesson.instruction:
Listen and answer the questions. 听录音并回答问题。

Fifteen pictures show completed actions. Listen to the recording and answer: What have you done? 十五幅图片展示了已完成的动作。听录音并回答：你已经做了什么？
lesson.translation: Listen to the recording and identify which action has been completed in each picture.

questions.answer: She has aired the room.
They have cleaned their shoes.
He has opened the window.
He has sharpened his pencil.
She has turned on the television.
They have listened to the programme.
She has boiled the eggs.
She has answered the telephone.
She has emptied the basket.
He has asked a question.
She has typed the letter.
She has washed her hands.
He has walked across the park.
He has painted the bookcase.
She has dusted the cupboard.

lesson.title: Written exercises A — Put 'has' in the present-perfect sentences
lesson.instruction:
Look at these two sentences. 注意以下两个例句。

She has already aired the room.
She aired it this morning.

In which of these sentences can we put has? 在下面的句子中有一般过去时和现在完成时两种不同的时态。选出现完成时的句子，并填上 has。
lesson.translation: Add 'has' to each present-perfect sentence (not the past-simple sentence).
lesson.context: Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 86 key (img/key-085-090.jpg).

questions.answer: has

questions.prompt: 2. She ______ boiled it a minute ago.
questions.answer: (no has — past simple)

questions.prompt: 3. She ______ never been to China, but he was there in 1992.
questions.answer: has
has

questions.prompt: 5. He ______ painted it a week ago.
questions.answer: (no has — past simple)

questions.prompt: 6. She ______ emptied the basket this morning.
questions.answer: (no has — past simple)
has

lesson.title: Written exercises B — Rewrite the imperatives
lesson.instruction:
Rewrite these sentences. 模仿例句改写以下祈使句。

Example:
Air the room! (this morning)
→ I've already aired the room. / I aired the room this morning.
lesson.translation: Rewrite each imperative as a present-perfect sentence ('I've already...') and a past-simple sentence with the given time expression.

questions.answer: I've already cleaned my shoes. / I cleaned my shoes last night.
I've already opened the window. / I opened the window an hour ago.
I've already sharpened my pencil. / I sharpened my pencil a minute ago.

questions.prompt: 4. Turn on the television! (ten minutes ago)
questions.answer: I've already turned on the television. / I turned on the television ten minutes ago.
I've already boiled the milk. / I boiled the milk yesterday morning.
I've already emptied the basket. / I emptied the basket yesterday.
I've already asked a question. / I asked a question two minutes ago.
I've already typed that letter. / I typed that letter this morning.
I've already washed my hands. / I washed my hands five minutes ago.

questions.prompt: 10. Walk across the park! (an hour ago)
questions.answer: I've already walked across the park. / I walked across the park an hour ago.
I've already painted that bookcase. / I painted that bookcase a year ago.
I've already dusted the cupboard. / I dusted the cupboard this afternoon.

practice.title: A — Has he ever been to...?
practice.instruction:
Look at this. 请看下表。

A: Have you ever been to America?  B: Yes, I have. I was there three years ago. or No, I haven't. I've never been to America.

Write conversations from these prompts. 根据提示完成以下对话。
practice.translation: Write a short conversation (question + answer) for each prompt, following the example.
practice.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-5 are taken from the supplied Lesson 86 key (img/key-085-090.jpg).

questions.answer: Has Ken ever been to Paris? / Yes, he has. He was there in April.
Have you ever been to London? / Yes, I have. I was there in 1997.
Has Carol ever been to Australia? / No, she hasn't. She has never been to Australia.

questions.prompt: 4. your friends / to England? / Yes / six months ago
questions.answer: Have your friends ever been to England? / Yes, they have. They were there six months ago.

questions.prompt: 5. Sam and Carol / to China? / No / never
questions.answer: Have Sam and Carol ever been to China? / No, they haven't. They have never been to China.

practice.title: B — I've already done it. I did it an hour ago.
practice.instruction:
Complete sentences 2-4 like sentence 1. 模仿例句完成以下句子。

1. I have already listened to the news. I listened to it at two o'clock. (listen)
practice.translation: Complete each sentence with the present-perfect and past-simple forms of the verb in brackets.
practice.context: Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 86 key (img/key-085-090.jpg).

questions.prompt: 2. She ______ your letters. She ______ them an hour ago. (type)
questions.answer: has already typed, typed
typed

questions.prompt: 3. They ______ their shoes. They ______ them this morning. (clean)
questions.answer: have already cleaned, cleaned
cleaned

questions.prompt: 4. Mum ______ a meal. She ______ it at 6 o'clock. (cook)
questions.answer: has already cooked, cooked
cooked

practice.title: C — Situations
practice.instruction:
Read each situation carefully. What do you say? 根据以下情景写出你应该说的话。

1. You want to know what film is being shown at the Roxy Cinema this week. What do you ask a friend?
2. A friend has been to see a new film. You want to know what it was like.
practice.translation: Write the question you would ask in each situation.
practice.context: Answers are taken from the supplied Lesson 86 key (img/key-085-090.jpg).

questions.prompt: 1. You want to know what film is being shown at the Roxy Cinema this week. What do you ask a friend?
questions.answer: What's on at the Roxy Cinema this week?

questions.prompt: 2. A friend has been to see a new film. You want to know what it was like.
questions.answer: What was it / the film like?

grammar.title: I. Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
grammar.instruction:
Answer the questions according to the example. 仿照例句回答下列问题。
Example: 1. Have you washed your hands and face? → I've already washed my hands, but I haven't washed my face.
grammar.translation: Answer each "and" question with a present-perfect positive and a past-simple negative (or vice versa), following the example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=502
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-8 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 502).

questions.prompt: 1. Have you washed your hands and face?
questions.answer: I've already washed my hands, but I haven't washed my face.

questions.prompt: 2. Has he done his homework and the housework?
questions.answer: He's already done his homework, but he hasn't done the housework.

questions.prompt: 3. Have they painted the doors and windows?
questions.answer: They've already painted the doors, but they haven't painted the windows.

questions.prompt: 4. Has she typed the letter and posted it?
questions.answer: She's already typed the letter, but she hasn't posted it.

questions.prompt: 5. Have you dusted the table and chairs?
questions.answer: I've already dusted the table, but I haven't dusted the chairs.

questions.prompt: 6. Has she telephoned Jane and Jack?
questions.answer: She's already telephoned Jane, but she hasn't telephoned Jack.

questions.prompt: 7. Have you been to London and Paris?
questions.answer: I've already been to London, but I haven't been to Paris.

questions.prompt: 8. Have you aired the room and cleaned the floor?
questions.answer: I've already aired the room, but I haven't cleaned the floor.

grammar.title: II. Give correct replies to the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。
grammar.instruction:
Give correct replies to the sentences according to the example. 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。
Example: 1. The windows are closed. (I) → Yes, I've just closed them.
grammar.translation: Give a present-perfect reply to each observation, following the example.
grammar.key_source: ../pdf/新概念英语语法练习1_按课程索引.pdf#page=502
grammar.context: Item 1 is a printed example (not editable). Items 2-10 are taken from the grammar key (PDF viewer page 502).

questions.answer: Yes, I've just closed them.
Yes, Tom's just opened it.
Yes, Mum's just cleaned it.
Yes, Mary's just turned it on.
Yes, Emma's just dried them.
Yes, Dad's just turned them off.

questions.prompt: 7. The magazines are on the shelf. (I)
questions.answer: Yes, I've just put them there/on the shelf.

questions.prompt: 8. The shirts and trousers are wet. (Jane)
questions.answer: Yes, Jane's just washed them.
Yes, Sam has just emptied it.

questions.prompt: 10. The cups and glasses are in the cupboard. (I)
questions.answer: Yes, I've just put them there/in the cupboard.
